work.abstract_text: We give an alternative proof, after Shi-Mei Ma (2026) and Principia Math in Progress (2026, Theorem 1), of Sagan and Swanson's Conjecture 7.6 (arXiv:2205.14078v1, Section 7.5, p. 40, posed May 27, 2022), using concentric interval layers for all four unshifted families. All four unshifted q-Stirling families are bottom heavy: each coefficient below the middle is at least its reflected coefficient. Concentric interval layers give an elementary proof for every nonnegative linear combination of products of q-integers. The layers give coefficient injections, an exact formula for the reflection defect, and a classification of symmetric entries. We deduce complex-reflection-group consequences and a closed alternating-sum formula clarifying the symmetry in the source's Conjecture 7.9.

authors.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

work.title: Coefficient injections and equality for Sagan–Swanson bottom heaviness: an alternative proof after Ma and Principia Math
